prompt: Complete the command that reads a score-tied leaderboard range in lexicographic member order.
explanation: When every member shares one score, ordering by score carries no information, so BYLEX switches ZRANGE to lexicographic member order — useful for alphabetical listings such as autocomplete dictionaries over equal-score members.
template: All members of board share the score 0. ZRANGE board 0 -1 ___ returns them in lexicographic member order.
